title: Satisfaction of generated clauses
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $L$ and $A$ be finite lists of literals on $n$ coordinates whose indices are pairwise distinct within each list and disjoint between the lists, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$ be an assignment. Every clause in the chain constructed from $L$ using the auxiliary literals in $A$ contains a literal satisfied by $x$ if and only if every corresponding clause term evaluates to $-1$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: The two literal lists have pairwise distinct indices within each list
The index sets of the two lists are disjoint
